detail.longDescription:
Turn screen time into learning time with Boddle, the research-backed 3D learning game for grades K–6.

Boddle helps students practice math, English language arts, and science through quests, pet battles, mini-games, and rewards. Personalized learning adjusts to each student’s level, identifies skill gaps, and gives parents and teachers clear progress reports.

Used by more than 15 million students, parents, and teachers, Boddle makes healthy, purposeful screen time easier at home and in the classroom.


HEALTHY SCREEN TIME THAT FEELS LIKE PLAY
Boddle turns learning practice into an adventure students are excited to continue:
• Practice real academic skills while exploring a colorful 3D world
• Build positive learning habits through quests, goals, and daily rewards
• Collect and battle pets, customize characters, and play mini-games
• Learn independently at school, at home, or on the go
• Connect with classmates through a kid-friendly experience with no open chat or strangers


K–6 MATH, READING, AND SCIENCE
Boddle includes standards-aligned lessons, questions, and activities developed by educators and instructional experts.

Math practice includes:
• Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division
• Math facts, times tables, and math fluency
• Fractions, decimals, ratios, and percentages
• Geometry, measurement, data, and graphs
• Word problems, number sense, and problem solving

Reading and English language arts practice includes:
• Phonics, spelling, vocabulary, and grammar
• Reading fluency and reading comprehension
• Fiction, non-fiction, language, and foundational literacy skills

Science practice includes:
• Life science, physical science, and Earth and space science
• Engineering, scientific thinking, and real-world problem solving
• NGSS-aligned practice for grades K–6


PERSONALIZED FOR EVERY LEARNER
Boddle begins by finding the right starting point for each student, then adapts practice based on their skills and pace. Students receive extra support when they need it and more challenge when they are ready.

• Automatically identify learning gaps
• Adjust question difficulty in real time
• Support intervention, enrichment, and independent practice
• Help students learn from mistakes with lessons and explanations


FOR TEACHERS
Turn classroom practice into a learning game students ask to play.

• Assign standards-aligned math, ELA, and science skills
• Create assignments and assessments
• Monitor individual and classroom progress
• View automatically graded reports
• Support targeted practice, intervention, and enrichment
• Use Boddle for centers, early finishers, homework, review, or whole-class activities

FOR PARENTS
Give your child screen time you can feel good about.

• Track progress, growth, mastered skills, and learning gaps
• Create assignments and assessments for extra practice
• Review automatically graded results
• Support homework, homeschool, tutoring, and summer learning
• Keep students motivated without relying on worksheets alone


STANDARDS-ALIGNED AND RESEARCH-BACKED
Boddle is trusted by more than 650,000 educators in all 50 states. Its curriculum aligns with widely used standards, including Common Core, TEKS, Florida B.E.S.T., and NGSS.
An independent study met ESSA Level III standards for Promising Evidence.

SAFE FOR STUDENTS
Boddle is built for student safety, with no open chat and no strangers. It is kidSAFE Certified and designed to support COPPA and FERPA compliance.

WHY BODDLE?
Boddle’s bottle-headed characters fill up as students learn, reminding them to fill up with knowledge, value the content of their character, and pour back into the world around them.
